posts.title: BCES 2.0: Now with weighted least squares
posts.description: I just released a major new version of BCES , the Python package for linear regression with measurement errors. In version 2.0, the big addition is weighted least squares (WLS) regression. posts.title: You are probably overpaying for intelligence
posts.description: Abstract The leading AI models keep getting more expensive, but are they worth it? posts.title: pip-select, an interactive tool for updating pip-installed python packages (conda-friendly)
posts.description: I was tired of manually figuring out which of my pip-installed packages need to be updated while excluding the conda ones, so I just created a tool that takes care of this. You fire pip-select , and it will check which of your pip packages can be updated while excluding the ones managed by conda, with a nice progress bar: Conda environment detected at: /home/user/miniconda3/envs/myenv Detected 84
